entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Boy, did you pick
a
great
moment
to
stop
on by![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_01

entries.text: Take a look at this![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_02

entries.text: This is supposed to be a sample from my mom’s\nresearch from back when she was a student![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_03a

entries.text: This is supposed to be a sample from my dad’s\nresearch from back when he was a student![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_03b

entries.text: Hehe, that’s what Director Clavell here told me.\nHe’s been helping me out.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_04

entries.text: When Sada was a student at this academy, I was\nstill a mere researcher myself.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_01a

entries.text: When Turo was a student at this academy, I was\nstill a mere researcher myself.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_01b

entries.text: Among my peers, it was already being bandied\nabout that an astoundingly gifted young woman\r\nwas studying at Naranja Academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_02a

entries.text: Among my peers, it was already being bandied\nabout that an astoundingly gifted young man was\r\nstudying at Uva Academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_02b

entries.text: So she really was always amazing...right from the\nstart, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_05a

entries.text: So he really was always amazing...right from the\nstart, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_05b

entries.text: Oh! I guess I never really questioned it, but...\nwhy IS your office full of all this equipment?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_06

entries.text: Ho! So you’ve finally noticed, have you?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_03

entries.text: This room was once your mother’s research lab.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_04a

entries.text: This room was once your father’s research lab.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_04b

entries.text:
From what I’ve heard recounted, [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0001)]she apparently
would become so absorbed in h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]eris research that
[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0001)]she hardly ever returned to h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]eris dorm room.\c
[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0102)]ShHe spent most nights sleeping here, in fact.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_05

entries.text: I also find myself more at ease surrounded by\nsuch research equipment, so I took the liberty\r\nof adapting the room to serve as my office.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_06

entries.text: I never knew...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_07

entries.text: All these pieces of my mom’s life—they were\nright in front of me this whole time...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_08a

entries.text: All these pieces of my dad’s life—they were\nright in front of me this whole time...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_08b

entries.text: I spent so long trying not to think about h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]erim\nthat I never even noticed...until now.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_09

entries.text: Thanks for telling me about this, Director Clavell![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_10

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], thanks for being
here
with
me
to
learn
about
it, too![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_11

entries.text: Ah, Master Arven! I also intended to explain\nabout these trophies here—[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_07

entries.text:
And he is already gone. Rather hard to pin down,
isn’t he?\c
Off like a flash as soon as some new thought
crosses his mind.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_08

entries.text: My dear Sada...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_09a

entries.text: My dear Turo...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_09b

entries.text: I think that son of yours takes after you a very\ngreat deal.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_b_head_10
